text: それじゃ　ポケモン　リーグ　いくまえに　レッドで　ウォーミング　アップと　いくか！

structure.jp: ポケモン　リーグ　いくまえに
structure.en: before going to the Pokémon League

structure.jp: ウォーミング　アップと　いくか！
structure.en: shall I get on with a warm-up!

patterns.name: 〜といく
patterns.span: ウォーミング　アップと　いくか
patterns.explanation: A thing plus と　いく means 'go for that, get on with that'; the か at the end is the speaker talking himself into it. ウォーミング　アップと　いくか = 'let's go with a warm-up, shall I'.

patterns.name: 〜まえに
patterns.explanation: A verb in its plain form plus まえに means 'before doing that'. いくまえに = 'before I go'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what is used to get something done. He is treating Red as a tool. レッドで = 'using Red'.
